# ApexStore Enterprise E-Commerce SaaS Catalog

Welcome to our AI readable storefront directory. Below are the root details of catalog models and platform capabilities.

## Base Endpoint
https://apexstore.com/api/v1

## Primary Catalog Categories
- **Electronics**: Smart appliances, wireless accessories, and audio gear.
- **Fashion & Apparel**: High-quality stretch leggings, sportswear, and style choices.
- **Home & Kitchen**: Advanced cooking accessories and smart ovens.
- **Fitness & Sports**: Carbon hybrid cycling equipment and gear.

## Support Services
Support tickets and chats are available under `/support`.

## AI-Discovery Spec
UCP metadata details are published at `/ai-discovery.json` and `/model-context.json`.
